milestones.title: Sprint A · Quick wins
milestones.description: Buildable right now over data the backend already has, with no Drops persistence needed. Delete the dead 'Coming soon' panels and live UI bugs on the streamer surfaces. Stage: Now.

milestones.title: Sprint B · Drops keystone
milestones.description: The drop-history DATA LAYER. Persist every giveaway result (streamer, trigger, winner, skin, delivery status, entrants snapshot, timestamps) plus a draw-audit trail, and expose read endpoints. This is the keystone: today the orchestrator only logs the result, so most real-data surfaces have nothing to show. Stage: Next.

milestones.title: Sprint C · Real-data surfaces
milestones.description: Cheap once Drops lands. The panels are already built and commented out behind <ComingSoon/> — wiring is a swap of mock context for a query hook. Turns the keystone into visible product: dashboard, history, viewer my-drops, profile realness. Stage: Later.

milestones.title: Sprint D · New features
milestones.description: Needs genuinely new backend, not just an uncomment: new rule fields, orchestrator enforcement, and the missing save mutation. Do after Drops, off the critical path. Stage: Later.

milestones.title: Sprint E · Parked
milestones.description: The discovery graph. Decide, don't build now — a directory and a follow system are empty pre-scale. Recorded decisions, not active work. Stage: Parked.

issues.title: DZ-31 Dashboard: wire the Triggers-summary panel
issues.body:
**Description:** On `/streamer/dashboard` the Triggers-summary panel renders "Coming soon" with the real markup commented out — even though the underlying trigger rules **already work** on `/streamer/triggers`. Pure frontend wiring over an endpoint that already exists; no money-track dependency.

**Backend dependency:** None. Reuse the existing `useGiveawaySettings` query against the live `GiveawaySettingsController` contract.

**Work:** Re-map the commented markup to the real `GameTrigger` shape (`triggerType` / `isEnabled` / `winnersCount` / `maxPrizeAmount` / `iconName`) and remove the `<ComingSoon/>` gate on this panel only.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Dashboard shows each configured game's live trigger state
- [ ] Toggling a trigger on `/streamer/triggers` is reflected on the dashboard after refetch
- [ ] No mock rows remain in this panel

**Route fixed:** `/streamer/dashboard` (Triggers-summary panel).

issues.title: DZ-32 /streamer/health: new GET /streamer/health endpoint + wire the page
issues.body:
**Description:** `/streamer/health` is a placeholder with a full status UI already built and commented out. Build the aggregating endpoint and light up the 3 derivable rows now; leave the trade-queue row honestly stubbed until a queue source exists.

**Backend dependency:** New `GET /streamer/health` that aggregates `StreamerSessionCache` presence + `IsStreamLiveAsync` + a **new GSI last-seen timestamp** (tiny instrumentation on the GSI action receiver). Mostly in-memory already.

**Work:** Ship the 3 derivable rows (session present, stream live, last GSI seen); leave the trade-queue row stubbed with a clear label; uncomment and wire the health page UI.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Page renders live values for the 3 derivable rows
- [ ] Last-seen updates as GSI packets arrive
- [ ] No fabricated queue depth is shown

**Route fixed:** `/streamer/health`.

issues.title: DZ-33 Profile "Member since" bug (shows today)
issues.body:
**Description:** The profile "Member since" value is computed with `new Date()`, so it always renders today's date. This is a live trust bug on a page every streamer sees. The real value is already persisted as `UserPlatformInfo.CreatedAt` — it just isn't surfaced.

**Backend dependency:** Thin. `CreatedAt` is already persisted; add it to the `/user/me` response.

**Work:** Surface `UserPlatformInfo.CreatedAt` through `/user/me` -> extend the `UserData` type -> replace the hardcoded `new Date()` in the profile join-date field.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] "Member since" shows the true account-creation date
- [ ] A freshly created account and an old account render different dates

**Route fixed:** `/streamer/profile` (Member since field). Broader profile realness is DZ-17.

issues.title: DZ-11 Profile ShareOption rules-of-hooks crash + "Opps!" typo
issues.body:
**Description:** The profile `ShareOption` component early-returns before its hooks run, so toggling the Steam connection can crash React (violates the Rules of Hooks). The error state also carries an "Opps! Something gone wrong" typo.

**Backend dependency:** None.

**Work:** Move all hooks above any conditional return; enable the react-hooks lint rule to catch regressions; fix the error-state copy.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Toggling Steam connection never crashes
- [ ] Lint enforces hook ordering
- [ ] The "Opps!" copy is corrected

**Route fixed:** `/streamer/profile` (ShareOption / Steam-connection toggle).

issues.title: DZ-16 Coming-soon widget dead buttons (Back to App / Request a Feature)
issues.body:
**Description:** The shared coming-soon layout's "Back to App" and "Request a Feature" buttons have no click handlers, so they do nothing on the 5+ pages that render this widget.

**Backend dependency:** None.

**Work:** Wire "Back to App" -> `router.back()` or the role home; wire "Request a Feature" -> the support form or Discord link.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] "Back to App" navigates correctly on every coming-soon surface
- [ ] "Request a Feature" opens the support/feedback destination

**Route fixed:** every page using the shared coming-soon widget (health, my-drops, live-streams, followings, etc.).

issues.title: DZ-34 Reconcile the maxDropsPerWiewer typo before DZ-21
issues.body:
**Description:** The zod schema, form defaults, and controller field name carry a `maxDropsPerWiewer` typo. Settle the canonical `maxDropsPerViewer` name now — cheaply — before DZ-21 builds real persistence and enforcement on top of that field.

**Backend dependency:** Thin. The controller/DTO field name is part of the rename; no new persistence.

**Work:** Rename to `maxDropsPerViewer` across the zod schema, the form defaults, and the controller/DTO; verify the value round-trips; ensure no runtime reference still uses the misspelled key.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] The field is spelled `maxDropsPerViewer` consistently across schema, defaults, and controller
- [ ] The value round-trips through save/load
- [ ] No reference to the old spelling remains

**Route fixed:** `/streamer/triggers` (config form + settings contract).

issues.title: DZ-01 DB schema: Drops + DrawAudit tables/entities + migration
issues.body:
**Description:** There is no `Drops` table, no `DrawAudit` table, no entity, and no migration. This is the persistence half of the keystone: a durable record per giveaway so the real-data surfaces have something to read.

**Backend dependency:** This is the backend work. Note `db/init.sql` is empty — schema comes from EF migrations only.

**Work:**
- `Drops` entity + DbSet: streamer, trigger, winner, skin (+ rarity), delivery/trade status, entrants snapshot, timestamps.
- `DrawAudit` entity + DbSet: entrants snapshot/count, winner, seed, timestamp.
- One EF migration that applies clean.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Migration applies clean on a fresh DB
- [ ] `Drops` + `DrawAudit` entities and DbSets exist for DZ-08 to write into
- [ ] Fields cover everything the real-data surfaces (DZ-13/14/15/17) need to render

**Route fixed:** none directly — the data layer that unblocks `/streamer/dashboard`, `/streamer/history`, `/viewer/my-drops`, and `/streamer/profile`.

issues.title: DZ-08 Persist every drop: orchestrator write-path + read endpoints
issues.body:
**Description:** Today `GiveawayOrchestrator.StartGiveaway` draws a winner, buys + delivers the skin, and then persists **nothing** — the result is only logged. That missing write-path is the root cause behind most placeholder surfaces: dashboard stats + feed, history, profile Statistics/Prizes, and viewer my-drops all have no data to show.

**Backend dependency:** Depends on DZ-01 (Drops + DrawAudit entities).

**Work:**
- Orchestrator writes a `Drops` + `DrawAudit` row per giveaway `{ timestamp, channel, winner, trigger, skin + rarity, rewardUsd, tradeStatus, deliveryState, entrants snapshot }` — replacing the log-only path.
- Record the entrant count and draw seed on the audit row.
- Add streamer-scoped **and** viewer-scoped paginated read endpoints.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Every drop produces a persisted `Drops` + `DrawAudit` row
- [ ] Streamer-scoped and viewer-scoped read endpoints return the rows, paginated
- [ ] "Which drop, when, who won, what was sent" is answerable from the data

**Route fixed:** none directly — unblocks the real-data wiring on `/streamer/dashboard`, `/streamer/history`, `/viewer/my-drops`, `/streamer/profile`.

issues.title: DZ-42 Epic: fill or kill the placeholder surfaces
issues.body:
**Description:** Umbrella tracking issue for this repo — convert the app's `<ComingSoon/>` panels and mock data into real product, or explicitly park them. A slice is fake exactly when its `*-storage.tsx` serves consts instead of a query hook; most are already built and commented out, so once the Drops keystone lands the wiring is cheap.

**Backend dependency:** The keystone (DZ-01 + DZ-08) unblocks the wire-ups; the parked and new-feature items track their own backend.

**Work / children:**
- Quick wins: DZ-31, DZ-32, DZ-33, DZ-11, DZ-16, DZ-34.
- Keystone: DZ-01, DZ-08.
- Wire on real data: DZ-13, DZ-14, DZ-15, DZ-17.
- New feature: DZ-21.
- Parked decisions: DZ-20, DZ-46.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Every placeholder surface is either wired to real data or has a recorded park decision
- [ ] No user-visible mock numbers remain on a surface a real user reaches
- [ ] All child tickets are resolved or explicitly parked

**Route fixed:** all 8 placeholder routes (umbrella).

issues.title: DZ-13 Dashboard on real data: stats cards + event feed
issues.body:
**Description:** `/streamer/dashboard` shows 4 stat cards reading "Coming soon" and a **fake** "Live" event feed (hardcoded s1mple / ZywOo, a literal "1189 today" badge). The markup is commented out behind `<ComingSoon/>`; the only thing missing is data.

**Backend dependency:** DZ-08 (Drops persistence). Build all four cards behind **one** `GET /streamer/dashboard-stats` — do not ship 2-of-4.

**Work:** Uncomment the four cards and feed them the single aggregate endpoint; wire the event feed to real Drops data and remove the literal "1189 today" badge; **relabel "Viewers" -> "Eligible viewers"** (the cache only holds giveaway-joined viewers, not total concurrents).

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] All four cards show real aggregates from Drops
- [ ] The event feed shows real drops; no hardcoded creator names or "1189 today" literal
- [ ] The card reads "Eligible viewers", not a fabricated concurrents number

**Route fixed:** `/streamer/dashboard` (4 stat cards + event feed).

issues.title: DZ-14 History on real data: uncomment RewardsTable + streamer read hook
issues.body:
**Description:** `/streamer/history` shows a placeholder with ~30 fake rows; the real `RewardsTable` is commented out behind `<ComingSoon/>`.

**Backend dependency:** DZ-08 (streamer-scoped paginated Drops read).

**Work:** Wire `RewardsTable` to the streamer Drops query hook and uncomment it; remove the mock storage. Leave the Filter/Export buttons decorative until a customer asks.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] History renders the streamer's real past drops, paginated
- [ ] An account with no drops shows the real empty state
- [ ] No mock rows remain

**Route fixed:** `/streamer/history`.

issues.title: DZ-15 Viewer my-drops on real data (the win-proof surface)
issues.body:
**Description:** `/viewer/my-drops` is the viewer's win-proof / shareable-brag surface — today 20 fake `DropItem`s and a coming-soon page. This is the viral loop GTM cares most about, so it is the first thing to wire once the keystone lands.

**Backend dependency:** DZ-08 (Drops filtered by winner + delivery status, viewer-scoped read).

**Work:** Swap the const-context for a viewer Drops query hook, uncomment the UI, drop `ComingSoonLayout`. Stub "Watch Time" (no source yet) with a clear label rather than faking it.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] A viewer who won a drop sees it with real skin, value, timestamp, and delivery state
- [ ] A viewer with no wins sees the real empty state
- [ ] No fabricated "Watch Time" is shown

**Route fixed:** `/viewer/my-drops`.

issues.title: DZ-17 Profile realness: Statistics + My Prizes panels + participation badge
issues.body:
**Description:** Broader profile realness beyond the DZ-33 Member-since fix. On `/streamer/profile` the participation badge is hardcoded "Inactive", the Statistics panel is coming-soon over mock consts, and My Prizes is coming-soon (empty-state only — the prize grid is net-new UI).

**Backend dependency:** DZ-08 (Drops aggregate + read endpoint).

**Work:** Derive the participation badge from real activity; uncomment Statistics and feed aggregates computed over Drops; build the My Prizes grid over the user/viewer Drops read endpoint.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Statistics reflect the user's real drop history; a new user shows zeros, not mock values
- [ ] The participation badge reflects real activity
- [ ] A user with prizes sees them in a grid with skin art + delivery state; empty state unchanged for users with none

**Route fixed:** `/streamer/profile` (Statistics + My Prizes + participation badge).

issues.title: DZ-21 Triggers phase 2: Drop Logic + Viewer Requirements
issues.body:
**Description:** On `/streamer/triggers` the Game-Triggers list already works, but the Drop Logic + Viewer Requirements panels read "Coming soon". These are fully-built forms commented out behind `<ComingSoon/>` — but the **backend has no fields for them and the form has no save wiring**, so this is a real feature, not an uncomment. Today `GetWinnerRandomly` is pure `Random()`: no cooldown, dedup, watch-time, subscriber, or account-age gate.

**Backend dependency:** New feature. Migration for `winnerSelection` / `minWatchTime` / `cooldown` / `maxDropsPerViewer` / `eventDedupWindow` + the viewer gates; DTO / service / controller persistence; real orchestrator enforcement. Prerequisite: the `maxDropsPerViewer` typo (DZ-34) must be settled first.

**Work:** Build the schema + persistence for the new rule fields; enforce cooldown / dedup / watch-time / subscriber / account-age in the orchestrator's winner selection; build the missing save mutation for the commented forms.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] Drop Logic + Viewer Requirements rules persist and round-trip
- [ ] The orchestrator actually enforces cooldown / dedup / watch-time / subscriber / account-age
- [ ] A farming pattern that wins repeatedly today is blocked

**Route fixed:** `/streamer/triggers` (Drop Logic + Viewer Requirements panels).

issues.title: DZ-20 /viewer/live-streams: park or scope
issues.body:
**Description:** `/viewer/live-streams` is a coming-soon directory over big mock sets. A directory listing a handful of streamers is empty UI pre-scale (worse than none — it advertises that the platform is tiny). Discovery is a strategy non-goal until 500+ weekly-active streamers. This ticket is a decision, not a build.

**Backend dependency:** None to keep parked; a real MVP would need a list of live sessions (in-memory presence exists).

**Work:** Decide kill vs minimal. If kept parked: leave the honest `<ComingSoon/>` shell and **delete the mock storage** so no half-mounted mock ships. Record the decision.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] A kill-vs-minimal decision is recorded
- [ ] No fake stream/directory data ships
- [ ] If parked, the mock storage is removed and the shell is an honest coming-soon

**Route fixed:** `/viewer/live-streams` (parked decision).

issues.title: DZ-46 /viewer/followings: park or build
issues.body:
**Description:** `/viewer/followings` is a placeholder with **no markup**. Building it needs a **net-new follow system** — a follow entity plus endpoints that do not exist. Same discovery non-goal as DZ-20; pre-scale you would maintain a follow table for no one. This ticket is a decision, not a committed build.

**Backend dependency:** Net-new — a follow entity + create/list/delete endpoints. None exist today.

**Work:** Decide park vs build. If parked: keep the honest coming-soon and record the decision. If ever built: design the follow entity + endpoints, then the frontend surface.

**Acceptance:**
- [ ] A park-vs-build decision is recorded with rationale
- [ ] No social-graph backend is built pre-scale unless the decision explicitly reverses
- [ ] If parked, the route stays an honest coming-soon

**Route fixed:** `/viewer/followings` (parked decision).
